summary: Iteration 6: full backend + frontend acceptance testing for Priority Flags and Structured AI Report. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (~28s). Verified (a) POST /api/reports with priority_level='High' + 2 flags (Labor Issue+reason, Change Order no reason) returns DailyReport with ai_summary containing all 7 markdown headers in exact order and a bullet matching /\[URGENT:\s*Labor Issue/i inside the DELAY / CONSTRAINTS section; (b) POST /api/reports without any priority fields returns priority_level=None, priority_flags=[] and still emits all 7 structured headers (backward compat); (c) GET /api/reports (list) and GET /api/reports/{id} both include priority_level + priority_flags; (d) POST /api/reports/{id}/regenerate-summary preserves priority context — regenerated ai_summary still contains [URGENT: Labor Issue …] under DELAY / CONSTRAINTS; (e) email path exercised via recipient_emails=['delivered@resend.dev'] (Resend sink) with priority_level='Medium' + Property Damage flag succeeds and still emits 7 headers; (f) FULL REGRESSION on iter 1-5 endpoints — auth/me, admin/users, visits/today, breaks/today, sms-logs/today, customers, digest/schedule, reports/{id}/workday-export, transcribe (400 no file), recipient-groups list, reports/{id}/portal-link, reports/{id}/signature (PATCH). All green. TTS NOT touched this run (per iter 6 budget note). Frontend E2E on 390x844 web preview: admin login -> Reports tab -> Create Report -> filled project_name='Priority Test 2' + highlights='Test priority run' -> tapped Labor Issue flag -> tapped Generate WITHOUT reason -> testID='report-error' displayed exact text 'Please add a reason for "Labor Issue".' (frontend guard verified). Then set priority=High, entered reason 'Sub short 1 man' (red-styled input), added Change Order flag, tapped Generate -> navigated to detail in ~10s -> [data-testid='priority-bar'] present, [data-testid='priority-level-chip'] shows 'HIGH PRIORITY' (red), Labor Issue + Change Order flag chips visible under bar, all 7 underlined section headers render via StructuredSummary (WORK COMPLETED, COMMUNICATIONS, WEATHER IMPACT, DELAY / CONSTRAINTS, CHANGE ORDER / MATERIALS, NEXT STEPS, OVERALL SUMMARY), customer/address/project-code amber-highlight pills visible (7425 Henderson Blvd SE, UI Test Customer, 1 UI Test St, 123 Main St, TEST_Acme Painters, ACME-01, UI-TEST). Back on Reports list — new 'Priority Test 2' row shows red 'HIGH' chip (testID report-priority-{id}); 'TEST_IT6_EmailSink' shows amber 'MEDIUM'.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking, carry-over from iterations 4 & 5.

action_items: No blocking issues. All iteration-6 acceptance criteria met (backend 21/21, frontend all flows green).
(Nit, carry-over from iter 5) `regenerated_at` is written to Mongo by regenerate-summary but not declared on DailyReport model, so callers never see the timestamp.
(Nit, carry-over) /app/backend/server.py is now 1675 lines — worth splitting into routers.
(Optional carry-over) Migrate deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:617-636 — the system prompt for build_ai_summary is well-structured; consider extracting the header list into a module-level constant so downstream renderers/tests can import the same source of truth (currently the same list is duplicated in StructuredSummary.tsx and _report_email_html section-parsing).

server.py:713-799 — create_report accepts priority_flags as `List[dict]` with no schema validation on the dict shape. A client sending `{'type': 42}` or a malformed reason will silently propagate into Mongo and the AI context. Recommend a Pydantic `PriorityFlag` sub-model (type: str, reason: Optional[str]).

server.py:1248-1275 — regenerate-summary rebuilds ai_context from the persisted doc which is correct, but does not re-emit the email or update `updated_at`. If the intent is that admins can 'fix a bad summary', consider also stamping updated_at so downstream digests pick up the fresh copy.

frontend PriorityPicker.tsx:87-97 — reason TextInput uses `multiline` without `numberOfLines` / `maxHeight`, so a very long reason can push the Generate button off-screen on 375-wide viewports. Consider a maxHeight or a trimmed preview.
